pages.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REQ
No. 746
Date
Shanghai Municipal Council.
December 2nd 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE JUNCTA IN UNO）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
The Shanghai Press Association has received a strongly worded telegram from the Chinese Territorial Preservation Society of Tientsin requesting it to advocate a boycott of French goods and complaining of the slackness of the Press association for not having taken action before.
The members of the Press Association discussed this matter last evening and decided to remain silent for the present.
The lawyers association which was formed in the City some time ago and which has forty six members is drawing up a petition to be sent to the Central Government protesting against the light sentence inflicted on ex-Taoyin Chow.
Liang Chi Tsao 梁啓超 arrived here from Canton 2 p.m. 1st inst. He is living in Connaught Road.
It is reported that representatives of the rebel begging party will leave Shanghai in a day or two to make a tour through the provinces seeking assistance.
The Kiangsi merchants residing in Shanghai will hold a meeting in Yu Yuen Garden at 2 p.m. 3rd inst to welcome Li Lieh Chun 李烈鈞 who arrived here on 19th ult from Canton.
Admiral Winterhalter arrived here from Peking at 6.55 p.m. 1st inst.

Your Obedient Servant,
McEwan
Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事调查处
情报官请求
第 746 号
日期
上海工部局。
1916年12月2日

（印章：上海工部局警务处 合众为一）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生，
上海报界公会收到来自天津中国国土保全会的一份措辞强烈的电报，要求该公会倡导抵制法货，并抱怨报界公会此前未采取行动，表现懈怠。
报界公会成员于昨晚讨论了此事，决定暂时保持沉默。
不久前在城内成立的律师协会拥有四十六名会员，目前正在起草一份呈送中央政府的请愿书，抗议对前道台周氏判处轻刑。
梁启超于本月1日下午2时从广州抵达此地。他现居住在康纳路（Connaught Road）。
据报，反叛乞援派的代表将在一两天内离开上海，前往各省巡游以寻求援助。
寓居上海的江西商人将于本月3日下午2时在豫园举行会议，欢迎李烈钧。李烈钧于上月19日从广州抵达此地。
温特哈尔特（Winterhalter）海军上将于本月1日下午6时55分从北京抵达此地。

您顺从的仆人，
麦克尤恩（McEwan）
侦探副督察。

警察总监
